description.en: SKOS concept scheme of movement purposes. POI classes point to these concepts with skos:related, and the purpose classification stage assigns them to trajectories through trajecto:hasPurpose.

publisher.value: i-Lab, Department of Cultural Technology and Communication, University of the Aegean

description.en: A SKOS concept scheme representing purposes of movement in trajectory data. Covers commercial, cultural, educational, recreational, residential, transportation, and work-related movement purposes.

definition.value: Concept scheme of the purposes a trajectory can be assigned.

title.value: Trajecto Purpose of Movement Concept Scheme
